testcase.name: [Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] kubelet should not use an anonymous user

[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] kubelet logs do not contain ErrImagePull unrecognized signature format
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] kubelet logs do not contain late lease update errors

[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] pathological event NodeHasSufficientPID condition does not occur too often
